_comment: Per-game maximum plausible score for the leaderboard. Any submitted score ABOVE the applicable ceiling is rejected outright (replaces the old useless 2-billion cap). 'default' applies to any game not listed in 'perGame'. As you learn a game's realistic top score, add an entry to 'perGame' keyed by its slug, e.g. "2048": 200000. Edited values load on server start.
